title: Implement a mustache-style template renderer
prompt:
src/template.mjs only does a naive `{{name}}` replace. We need a proper mustache-style render(template, data) for our notification emails:

- `{{ name }}` (whitespace inside the braces allowed) interpolates HTML-escaped: & < > " ' become & < > " '. `{{{name}}}` and `{{& name}}` interpolate without escaping.
- null/undefined/missing values render as an empty string; other values via String().
- Dotted names (`{{user.address.city}}`) and `{{.}}` (the current item).
- Name lookup uses a context stack like mustache: the first segment of a name is resolved by searching from the innermost context outwards; once found, the remaining segments are resolved only inside that value (no further fall-through).
- `{{#name}}...{{/name}}` renders once per element for a non-empty array (element pushed as the context), once with the value pushed for any other truthy value, and nothing for falsy values or empty arrays. `{{^name}}...{{/name}}` renders only when the value is falsy or an empty array. Sections nest, including sections with the same name.
- `{{! comment }}` renders nothing.
- Unclosed or mismatched section tags throw an Error.
- Whitespace and newlines around tags are kept verbatim (no standalone-line trimming).

Run `node --test "test/*.test.mjs"`.
